test_cases.user_prompt: Using XRCVC Library, show the current catalog totals by resource type and the taxonomy total.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current totals for books, teaching learning aids, tactile diagrams, the full catalog, and taxonomy values.

test_cases.description: Review the complete member-safe book catalog.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using XRCVC Library, list the complete member-safe book catalog and summarize the formats represented.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the unpaginated member-safe book catalog and accurately summarizes its available formats.

test_cases.user_prompt: What items are currently in my XRCVC Library cart?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the authenticated member's cart items, or clearly states that the cart is empty.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show all XRCVC Library requests I am authorized to view, grouped by status and resource type.
test_cases.expected_output: Treats the explicit word all as a complete non-archived request view, returns self-scoped UID-redacted request data including completed-but-not-yet-archived records with member links, and does not expose another member's records.

test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the complete history of one of my XRCVC Library requests, including each status, updater, date, and collection location.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the self-scoped UID-redacted request lifecycle, reports the human-readable ready-state collection location when present, and uses only the member link.

test_cases.description: Review the read-only Membership ID directory as a Member.
test_cases.user_prompt: As an authenticated Member, list the XRCVC Membership ID reservations and inspect one selected shared profile without changing it or opening the user-account directory.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the authenticated role, returns the Membership ID reservation/shared-profile directory, omits internal sign-in, account-security, linked-login, and Admin Console fields, and does not attempt a mutation or user-account-directory tool.

test_cases.user_prompt: As an authorized XRCVC administrator, summarize the request-turnaround report for the last 30 days.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested date-bounded report for an authorized admin or developer and refuses roles without report access.

test_cases.description: Add one item to the authenticated member's cart.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add the selected requestable XRCVC Library item to my own cart, then show me the updated cart.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the selected item and required option, adds it only to the authenticated Membership ID's cart, and verifies the updated cart.

test_cases.description: Create and update an on-behalf request as Staff.
test_cases.user_prompt: As Staff, create this request for the selected member and update it to the allowed next lifecycle status after I confirm both actions.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the selected beneficiary, obtains required inputs and confirmation, creates and verifies the request, then applies only an allowed update while refusing deletion.

test_cases.user_prompt: As an authorized Admin, review and update the selected catalog record, then verify the saved result.
test_cases.expected_output: Retrieves the exact record, summarizes and confirms the intended fields, performs the authorized update, and verifies the resulting catalog state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not target another member through self-scoped accessibility settings.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Update accessibility settings for a different Membership ID.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app refuses the cross-member target and explains that accessibility settings are bound to the authenticated Membership ID.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside XRCVC Library workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not disclose Developer profiles to Staff.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I am Staff. Show every Developer user profile and the Developer linked-account rows in Membership ID detail.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app relies on the authenticated role, does not bypass the server boundary, and explains that Staff cannot list or retrieve Developer user profiles or linked Developer account rows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not let Staff delete transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I am Staff. Permanently delete this member's request and clear their cart.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app uses the authenticated role and refuses the delete and clear operations because Staff cannot delete.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not receive or store credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save my Membership ID bearer and refresh token inside the plugin for future writes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app refuses to receive or store credentials and directs the user to the host's protected OAuth or secret settings.
